# Sefaria Client Feature Atlas

Master list of every feature in the current Sefaria web client, extracted from a full code read at commit `bb47dd7` (master, 2026-10-04).

**945 features**, 3582 documented behaviors. Proposed tiers: core 320, standard 412, optional 153, retire 60.

- **Tier** (proposal, for product to confirm): `core` can't launch without it · `standard` parity, can follow core · `optional` niche/rethink · `retire` unused, broken or superseded.
- **Rebuild status** (new reader): done 283 · partial 38 · todo 489 · replaced 18 · deferred 30 · n/a 87; 281 are covered by tagged tests. Corrections found while rebuilding are logged in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).
- **Status**: `live` · `legacy` (old Django/jQuery/CKEditor stack) · `unused` (code, no UI) · `broken` · `branch-only`.
- Detail bullets prefixed **BUG / DEAD / SECURITY** flag things not to port as-is.
- `features.json` is the same data, machine-readable. The `inv_*.md` files are the long-form write-ups each item's *Source* points to.

## Contents

- **Reader**: [Reader shell & panels](#reader-shell) (75) · [Text display & reading settings](#text-display) (69) · [Text types & special cases](#text-types) (27) · [Connections & resources sidebar](#connections) (71) · [Versions & translations](#versions) (21)

#### SHL-007 · Reading settings defaults
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Reading preferences start from sensible defaults, overridden by the user's saved cookies.

- Precedence: panel state, then props.initialSettings, then hard-coded defaults (ReaderApp.jsx:975-994).
- Defaults: language bilingual, layoutDefault segmented, layoutTalmud continuous, layoutTanakh segmented, aliyotTorah aliyotOff, vowels all, punctuationTalmud punctuationOn, biLayout stacked, color light, fontSize 62.5.
- Server initialSettings come from cookies with same defaults; language from request.contentLang (reader/views.py:353-363).

Code: [`static/js/ReaderApp.jsx:975`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/ReaderApp.jsx#L975), [`reader/views.py:353`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/reader/views.py#L353)

Source: `inv_02_reader_shell.md#6`

#### SHL-008 · Settings persistence in cookies
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Reading choices are remembered across visits.

- setOption writes every option to a cookie of the same name: $.cookie(option, value, {path:'/'}) (ReaderPanel.jsx:547).
- language also writes the contentLang cookie, sets replaceHistory=true and calls setDefaultOption so NEW panels inherit the language.
- Layout option name remapped to category-specific key via getLayoutCategory(): layoutTanakh/layoutTalmud for those primary categories, else layoutDefault (526-529).
- Any option other than fontSize closes the display settings menu (displaySettingsOpen=false).

Code: [`static/js/ReaderPanel.jsx:530`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/ReaderPanel.jsx#L530), [`static/js/ReaderPanel.jsx:526`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/ReaderPanel.jsx#L526)

Source: `inv_02_reader_shell.md#6`

#### SHL-020 · Settings menu show/hide rules per option
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **done** — Tagged tests; checked against sefaria.org in the parity runs · *tested*

Each option in the menu appears only when it applies to the text being read.

- Layout buttons hidden when (width <= 600 and bilingual) or (Sheet and not bilingual) (43-46).
- Aliyot toggle: only Genesis-Deuteronomy and Onkelos Genesis-Deuteronomy, not sheets; toggles aliyotTorah aliyotOn/Off (48-59); URL carries aliyot=0/1 for Torah refs (ReaderApp.jsx:686-688).
- Vowels toggle: only if sample text (first leaf of he or text, for visible side) contains nikud [ְ-׃ׇ]; toggles vowels none/partial (70-78).
- Cantillation toggle: only if sample contains te'amim [֑-֯]; disabled when vowels off; toggles partial/all (80-89). vowels is a 3-state setting all/partial/none.
- Punctuation toggle: only when primary_category === 'Talmud' and source visible; toggles punctuationTalmud On/Off (91-98).

Code: [`static/js/ReaderDisplayOptionsMenu.jsx:43`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/ReaderDisplayOptionsMenu.jsx#L43), [`static/js/ReaderApp.jsx:686`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/ReaderApp.jsx#L686)

### App bootstrap

#### SHL-022 · Client entry and hydration
`core` `live` · rebuild: **replaced** — TanStack Start entry, providers in src/routes/__root.tsx; no global props object

The client app boots from server-rendered HTML and takes over the page.

- client.jsx strips 'no_applink' query param via history.replaceState (14-18); inits Sentry with sample rates from remoteConfig.sentry (20-35); inits Django CSRF helper (40).
- Uses ReactDOM.hydrate, or render when #appLoading placeholder exists (41-44).
- With DJANGO_VARS.inReaderApp: renders full ReaderApp after Sefaria.unpackDataFromProps (45-50).

Code: [`static/js/client.jsx:14`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/client.jsx#L14), [`static/js/client.jsx:41`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/client.jsx#L41)

#### SHL-023 · Header-only mode over static pages
`core` `live` · rebuild: **n/a** — Header-only mode over Django static pages exists only because the old app bolts onto server-rendered pages

Static Django pages get the live header and nav; clicking into the app turns the page into the reader.

- Without inReaderApp, ReaderApp renders in headerMode over a static page with multiPanel = window.width > 600 (client.jsx:52-63).
- setSinglePanelState replaces all panels with one panel and sets headerMode:false - how a static page 'becomes' the app (ReaderApp.jsx:2076-2080).
- setContainerMode (995-1014): with panels/auth: removes #s2.headerOnly, body overflow hidden, adds .inApp, removes .hasBannerMessage; else adds headerOnly, overflow auto, removes inApp; called on update, popstate and Banner close.
- In headerMode, links on the static page outside React are bound to the same click handler via jQuery (220-224).
- No panels in headerMode: current path/query preserved with mode 'Header' in history (771-782).

Code: [`static/js/client.jsx:52`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/client.jsx#L52), [`static/js/ReaderApp.jsx:995`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/ReaderApp.jsx#L995), [`static/js/ReaderApp.jsx:2076`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/ReaderApp.jsx#L2076)

#### SHL-025 · Server-side single vs multi-panel decision
`core` `live` · rebuild: **replaced** — No user-agent sniffing: one responsive layout, the single-panel breakpoint is a CSS media query (max-width: 842px)

Mobile user agents get the single-panel reader; desktop gets multi-panel; ?mobile forces mobile.

- multiPanel = !request.user_agent.is_mobile && 'mobile' not in request.GET (reader/views.py:347).
- Client checks window.width > 600 in headerMode.
- FOUND 2026-10-05: sefaria.org decides single-panel mode from the User-Agent, not the width — a desktop browser squeezed to 390px keeps desktop rules (text x=56, sort dropdown on the Books tab) while a phone UA gets the phone rules (text x=34, filter button). The rebuild decides by width (≤842px) and, for the 34px text padding, by a coarse pointer.

### Multi-panel layout

#### SHL-039 · Panel cap and widths
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested* `desktop only`

The number of visible side-by-side panels depends on window width; special ratios give text more room.

- panelCap = floor(window.outerWidth/360), recomputed on resize (ReaderApp.jsx:1015-1024,216).
- Panels <= cap: even percentage widths; more than cap: 360px each plus wrapBoxScroll with box width = windowWidth (2389-2417).
- Special ratios: [Text|Sheet, Connections|search menu|compare] 68/32; [Text|Sheet, Connections, Text|Sheet] 37/26/37; [Text|Sheet, Text|Sheet, Connections] 37/37/26.
- Each panel box absolutely positioned with left (LTR) or right (RTL) offset = sum of previous widths (2444-2446); class 'sidebar' for Connections panels (2485).
- Panel React key = index + book title, so panels remount on shifting position or book change (2482-2484).
- VERIFIED 2026-10-04 at 1600px: [Text, Connections, Text] = 592/416/592px (37/26/37); four text/sidebar panels = 400px each (cap = floor(1600/360) = 4).

#### SHL-066 · Panel state to URL serialization (shell-specific rules)
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Multiple panels are encoded into a single URL, with short forms for the common text+sidebar case.

- Per-menu URL mapping in makeHistoryState (515-671); '&tab=' appended for non-search menus. Search: 'tab' means search type so results tab is 'search_tab'; search-state URL params prefix 't' (text) / 's' (sheet).
- Connections: 'sources' = filter joined '+', or connectionsMode if URL-representable (Sheets, Notes, Translations, Translation Open, Version Open, About, AboutSheet, Navigation, WebPages, extended notes, Topics, Torah Readings, manuscripts, Lexicon, SidebarSearch, Guide, LinkerAdmin), else 'all'. ConnectionsList filters get ' ConnectionsList' suffix; WebPagesList -> 'WebPage:{filter}'; SidebarSearch panel borrows previous panel's refs (690-723).
- Text URL = normRef(highlighted range if overlaps currentlyVisibleRef else currentlyVisibleRef); aliyot for Torah (672-688). Sheet: panel 0 /sheets/{id}[.{node}], later panels sheet&s={id.node} (752-762).
- Merging panels (784-891): panel 0 base URL + ven/vhe + &with= (mobile TextAndConnections) + &lang= + &aliyot= + &debug_mode=linker; short form for Text/Sheet + Connections first two panels; later connections &p{i}=&w{i}=...; other panels &p={url} with = suffixed by index; titles joined ' and '; '?' in titles encoded %3F.
- Titles: '{ref} with {mode}' localized via CONNECTION_MODE_STRING_IDS unless 'all'/ConnectionsList.
- BUG (VERIFIED 2026-10-04): panel numbers follow the flat panel array, sidebars included, so [Text+Connections, Text] is written as ?with=all&p3=Exodus.1 — and the server stops at the first missing p{i}, so reloading that URL silently drops the third panel. The rebuild numbers logical panels sequentially (p2, w2 for its sidebar), which the old server also reads, and accepts gaps when decoding.
- BUG (VERIFIED 2026-10-04): `lang2` means both 'panel 2 language' and 'first sidebar language' (/Genesis.1.1?with=all&p2=Exodus.1&lang2=en is rewritten to …&lang2=en&p3=Exodus.1&lang3=en).

#### SHL-067 · In-app link routing (openURL)
`core` `live` · rebuild: **partial** — Links in the text and sidebar navigate in-app; no global interception for arbitrary hrefs yet

Clicking internal links navigates within the app without a page reload when possible.

- openURL(href,replace,overrideContentLang,moduleTarget,signupSource) (1330-1456): confirms unsaved sheet-editor changes first (cancel -> 'handled', no navigation); resolves full URL via Sefaria.util.fullURL.
- Non-Sefaria URLs or links targeting another module open in NEW tab; in Voices, ABOUT_SIDEBAR_PAGES open in new Library tab (noopener,noreferrer).
- /login,/register -> in-app AuthPage with next; any other path hides auth.

### Rendering pipeline

#### TXD-002 · Reader text column renders sections of text
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

The reader shows a scrolling column of text sections, each made of numbered segments, in the main panel and side panels.

- Chain: ReaderPanel -> TextColumn -> TextRange (one per section ref) -> TextSegment -> VersionContent/ContentSpan.
- ReaderPanel builds TextColumn only for modes Text and TextAndConnections; provides ReaderPanelContext (language, layout, panelMode, textsData, aliyot/vowels/punctuation, width, panelPosition).
- VersionContent/ContentSpan render raw HTML via dangerouslySetInnerHTML as 'contentSpan he|en primary|translation'.
- ContentText is a generic bilingual renderer filtered by content language (useContentLang); used for titles, numbers, headers.
- Other TextRange consumers: TextList (connections), VersionsTextList, MyNotesPanel, GuideBox.

#### TXD-006 · Client picks source and translation versions
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

The reader decides which Hebrew/primary and translation versions to show using the user's selection, per-corpus preference and language preference.

- _getVersionObjects loads all versions (/api/texts/versions/<ref>). Primary = highest-priority isPrimary version matching currVersions.he, else {languageFamilyName:'primary'}.
- Translation: if currVersions.en.versionTitle set it must match a non-source version; else fallback order: (1) per-corpus preference getVersionPref(ref).en, (2) translationLanguagePreference bucket (highest-priority non-source), (3) {languageFamilyName:'translation'} (server picks highest priority).
- _findInVersions picks highest priority among matches.
- setVersionPreference records only en (translation) prefs per corpus and saves them to the profile.
- Per-corpus preference override applies only to panels 2+ on SSR (override_version_with_preference).

#### TXD-008 · Legacy text cache with per-segment entries
`core` `live` · rebuild: **replaced** — The legacy text shape, per-segment cache and request adapter are replaced by the normalised model and the section-level library cache

Fetched text is cached per segment and section so neighbors, context and spanning refs load instantly.

- _saveText stores by _textKey (ref + ven/vhe + transLangPref + FALLBACK + |CONTEXT); section data split into per-segment entries (_splitTextSection) each with nextSegment/prevSegment and a buildable 'Add Context' placeholder.
- Context saves a section-level copy; spanning refs prime every spanning section via getText.
- Super-sections (textDepth = sections+2, e.g. a commentary chapter): _splitTextSection computes next/prev per child section so empty sub-sections are skipped.
- index_offsets_by_depth (_get_offsets) lets numbering start at an offset; used in segment numbering and splitting.
- Sefaria.ref()/getRefFromCache is a cache-only synchronous lookup; infinite scroll depends on it so only prefetched neighbors chain. getRef is the promise form.
- _splitTextSection delimiter is ' ' when data.ref === data.book (depth-1 at root).

#### TXD-017 · TextRequestAdapter version resolution and payload
`core` `live` · rebuild: **replaced** — The legacy text shape, per-segment cache and request adapter are replaced by the normalised model and the section-level library cache `system`

The server resolves requested versions, merges gaps and returns text plus ref, index and node metadata.

- get_versions_for_query applies default_child_ref() first (default nodes of complex texts).
- _append_required_versions: exact vtitle match is strict, else max-priority (resolve_default_version); duplicates suppressed; unmatched to 'missings'.
- _append_version builds a TextChunk with merge_versions limited to the same languageFamilyName; attaches sources only if merged from >1 version; adds firstSectionRef for book-level refs; each version carries all Version fields (direction, isPrimary, isSource, formatAsPoetry, shortVersionTitle, status, license, priority, etc.).
- Ref data: ref, heRef, sections/toSections (normalized strings), sectionRef, heSectionRef, firstAvailableSectionRef, isSpanning/spanningRefs, next/prev, title, book, primary_category, type (=primary_category).
- Index/node data: indexTitle, categories, isComplex, isDependant, order, collectiveTitle, alts, lengths, textDepth, sectionNames, addressTypes, titleVariants, index_offsets_by_depth (skipped for virtual nodes).
- Top-level available_langs and available_versions (used by ReaderControls for shortVersionTitle).
- Debug_mode=linker adds raw LinkerOutput records.

`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

#### TXD-048 · Segment click routing
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Clicking different parts of a segment does different things: follow a citation, toggle a footnote, open a topic, or open connections.

#### TXD-052 · Infinite scroll up and down in the reader
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Readers scroll continuously through neighboring sections without page reloads.

- adjustInfiniteScroll: up when scrollTop < 75; down when last section bottom < viewport height + 80; handleTextLoad triggers down-only checks.
- Up: prepends prev plus up to 10 earlier cached sections (buildPreviousRefs); down: appends up to 10 cached next sections. Scroll position restored after top load (restoreScrollPositionAfterTopLoad).
- No adjustment while any .basetext.loading exists. Refs written via ReaderPanel.updateTextColumn (replaceHistory).
- InfiniteScroll.jsx is NOT the reader's; it is the search-results loader.
- Prefetch of next/prev section text with same versions.

#### TXD-068 · Jump-free reading: place keeping and pre-paint placement (rebuild)
`core` `rebuild-only` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

In the rebuild, nothing you are reading ever moves unless you scroll: sections added above, fonts arriving, the sidebar opening, font-size and layout changes all keep the current segment still, and a linked verse is in place from the first visible frame.

- Anchor = current segment; corrections in the same task as the change (layout effect / ResizeObserver), only content shifts corrected, never the reader's own scroll.
- Pre-hydration inline script positions the linked verse during HTML parsing, keeps it in place every frame until the app takes over, and holds the text invisible (≤600ms) while web fonts arrive.
- The focus only moves when the reader moves, in the direction of travel (no backwards URL step near the end of a chapter).
- Tested by e2e/smoothness.spec.ts (per-step jump analysis) and scripts/jank-probe.mjs.

### Torah

#### TXT-002 · Parashah and aliyah headers in Torah text
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** — Tagged tests; checked against sefaria.org in the parity runs · *tested*

Torah text shows parashah and aliyah headings inline, which readers can toggle.

- Backend get_trimmed_alt_structs_for_ref: jagged array mirroring text; at node start {en,he,whole:true}; per aliyah adds aliyah_en/he and parasha_en/he; Rishon (i==0) not added to title lists; covers all alt structs but client renders only Torah/Onkelos.
- SSR panel includes indexDetails for categories ['Tanakh','Torah'] 'for Torah Parashah titles rendered in text'.
- Haftarot not rendered inline; only via calendars/NavSidebar/topic pages. Tests: parashahHeader.test.js.

### Sidebar architecture

#### CON-004 · Resources sidebar panel placement (desktop/mobile)
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** — Tagged tests; checked against sefaria.org in the parity runs · *tested*

The resources sidebar opens beside the text on desktop and inside the same panel on mobile, inheriting the text panel's current filters and versions.

- Desktop: separate ReaderPanel mode 'Connections' to the right; ReaderApp.openTextListAt splices a new panel or reuses an existing Connections panel.
- Connections panel language forced to hebrew or english (never bilingual).
- Inherits filter, versionFilter, recentFilters, recentVersionFilters, currVersions from parent Text/Sheet panel.
- If parent has openSidebarAsConnect, sidebar opens in 'Add Connection' mode.
- Mobile: same ReaderPanel switches to mode 'TextAndConnections'; history is replaced (not pushed) while already in TextAndConnections.
- ReaderPanel.openConnectionsPanel picks desktop vs mobile route; ConnectionsPanel receives ~60 props.
- srefs = refs in Connections mode, highlightedRefs in TextAndConnections; fullPanel = multiPanel.
- canEditText = version not locked for current language OR (moderator and language not bilingual).
- Header: desktop renders ConnectionsPanelHeader inside ReaderControls; mobile ConnectionsPanel renders its own header.
- Outer div keyed by mode so every mode change remounts content; 'marginless' CSS modes: Resources, ConnectionsList, Advanced Tools, Share, WebPages, Topics, manuscripts.
- LoadingMessage shown until Sefaria.related(srefs[0]) resolves.

#### CON-006 · Sidebar mode switching and gating rules
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** — Tagged tests; checked against sefaria.org in the parity runs · *tested*

Switching sidebar tools is centralized: it tracks the click, enforces sign-in for some modes, and resets filters when returning to Resources.

- setVersionFilter: skips recentVersionFilters when previous mode was 'About'; mode 'Version Open' from About else 'Translation Open'; null -> 'Translations'.
- setWebPagesFilter -> 'WebPagesList'; editNote -> 'Edit Note' + noteBeingEdited; setSideScrollPosition stores scroll.
- viewExtendedNotes sets mode 'extended notes' and REPLACES panel.currVersions with only that version.

### Data layer

#### CON-071 · Related data API and caching
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** — Tagged tests; checked against sefaria.org in the parity runs · *tested* `system`

One call bundles links, sheets, topics, manuscripts, media and guides for a ref and is split per segment into caches.

- related(ref,cb)/relatedApi GET /api/related/<ref>?with_sheet_links=1; each type split per segment via _saveItemsByRef which keeps the larger cached list; _related[ref] holds original data.
- relatedPrivate GET /api/related/<ref>?private=1 (my sheets and notes; marks empty subrefs loaded).
- getLinks GET /api/links/<ref>?with_text=0 caches index stubs from collectiveTitle and essay displayedText terms; clearLinks resets _related, _links, _linkSummaries.
- getIndexDetails, getLexiconWords, privateNotes, webpagesApi, topicsByRef/postRefTopicLink, mediaByRef/manuscriptsByRef/guidesByRef, sheets.*, bookSearchPathFilterAPI, getGuide, pollTask, getTopic, saveUserHistory(secondary:true) support sidebar tools.
- VERIFIED 2026-10-05: connection counts include sheets from collections listed in the library, served as links when `with_sheet_links=1` (old client: /api/related?with_sheet_links=1). Genesis 1:1 Commentary = 958 with them, 957 without (/api/links?with_text=0 omits them; add with_sheet_links=1).

#### VER-002 · Version preferences by corpus cookie
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **partial** — Cookie read and written (a year); profile storage waits for auth · *tested*

The app remembers preferred versions per corpus.

- VersionPreferences maps corpus -> {lang: vtitle}; getVersionPref(ref) looks up index corpus; failures (sheets, missing index) return null; update is immutable.
- Every construction writes cookie version_preferences_by_corpus (JSON).
- ReaderApp itself only uses the per-book defaultVersions cache; VersionPreferences is consumed by the Sefaria singleton.
- VERIFIED 2026-10-05: the cookie is a SESSION cookie (no expiry) holding URL-encoded JSON {"Tanakh":{"en":"<title>"}}; choosing a German translation stores it under the 'en' key (the version's `language` field is 'en' for every translation). Signed-in users also save it to the profile (not ported).
- Rebuild difference: the cookie lasts a year (max-age=31536000) instead of the browser session.

#### VER-014 · Version resolution order
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested* `system`

Defines which version a passage is shown in when none is explicitly chosen.

- getTextFromCurrVersions/_getVersionObjects: explicit choice, then user's corpus translation preference, then translationLanguagePreference language, then default; withContext refetches the section.
- getVersions GET /api/texts/versions/<ref> buckets by actualLanguage and fills _translateVersions; getSourceVersions filters isPrimary; getTranslations filters isSource:false.
- VERIFIED 2026-10-05 (Exodus 1:1, signed out, cookies set by hand): no cookies → Revised JPS, 2023; version_preferences_by_corpus={"Tanakh":{"en":"The Koren Jerusalem Bible"}} → Koren; translation_language_preference=es → 'Alfredo cerhy [es]'; both → Koren (corpus preference wins); a preference naming a version the text lacks → default; explicit ?ven= beats the cookie.
- Client rule (Sefaria._getVersionObjects): explicit translation must exist among the text's non-source versions or it is dropped; the corpus preference must also exist for this text; the language preference takes the highest-`priority` translation whose bucket (title '[xx]' suffix, else `language`) matches. Corpus = `corpora[0]` of the book's index (/api/v2/raw/index/<title>); only some books have one (Tanakh, Mishnah, Bavli…).
- An unknown ?version= is not an error in /api/v3/texts: it answers 200 with the primary version only and a warning (code 101) — so preferences must be validated against available_versions before use.

Code: [`static/js/sefaria/sefaria.js:790`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/sefaria/sefaria.js#L790), [`static/js/sefaria/sefaria.js:931`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/sefaria/sefaria.js#L931), [`static/js/sefaria/sefaria.js:1053`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/sefaria/sefaria.js#L1053)

#### LIB-012 · Nested category sections and single-text collapse
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Within a category page, primary sub-categories become links, other sub-categories expand inline with their own heading, and a category containing one text shows that text directly.

- isPrimary OR nestLevel>0 category: if exactly one child and it is a text, render TextMenuItem directly (skip if hidden); else MenuItem link to /texts/<path>.
- Non-primary category: inline .category section with h2 inside CategoryHeader (admin edit per subcategory); recurse with nestLevel+1.
- Short description <=5 words shown inline in parentheses in the h2; >5 words shown as separate .categoryDescription.long block; chosen by content language.

#### BOK-010 · Schema node: collapsible complex sections
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** — Done in TocView; the book-page overlay not built · *tested*

Complex books show nested, collapsible sections in the contents; the section that holds the reader's place opens automatically.

- SchemaNode: child collapsed unless top-level, disableSubCollapse, leaf, contains the currently visible ref, is default node, or has includeSections; recomputed when currentlyVisibleRef changes.
- Children with nodes -> collapsible .schema-node-toc (collapsed/open, fixed if disableSubCollapse; Enter toggles; role heading level 3).
- depth==1 non-default JA child -> single link a.schema-node-toc.linked straight to '<refPath>, <title>' (e.g. Introduction), .current if matches.
- JA child depth>=2 or default node -> .janode with collapsible title (title omitted for default nodes) and JaggedArrayNode.
- Optional topLevelHeader (.specialNavSectionHeader, Hebrew via Sefaria.hebrewTranslation).
- Leaf dispatch by nodeType: JaggedArrayNode, ArrayMapNode (alt-struct leaf), DictionaryNode.
- VERIFIED 2026-10-05 (Pesach Haggadah): every top-level node with depth 1 is a single title link (Kadesh, Urchatz, …) to '<book>, <title>'; the current one is marked when it equals the section ref. At the top level nothing is collapsed (the collapsed array is empty), so collapsing only affects nested nodes.
- BUG (old, not ported): the collapsible titles are role=heading aria-hidden='true' with tabIndex 0 and an onClick — a focusable control hidden from assistive tech. Rebuild: a real button with aria-expanded.

## Search & autocomplete


### Header autocomplete

#### SRC-001 · Header search suggestions
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Typing in the header search box suggests books, topics, categories, collections, users and more.

- Built on downshift useCombobox (GeneralAutocomplete.jsx); suggestions fetched on every input change; Enter can be intercepted via onEnter.
- Only for input >= 3 chars (HeaderAutocomplete.jsx:404-406); calls Sefaria.getName(input,undefined,types,topic_pool); topic pool from getTopicPoolNameForModule.
- Allowed types: Library = Topic, ref, TocCategory, Term; Voices = Topic, User, Collection (42-45).
- URL mapping (104-116): Collection (Voices) /collections/{key}; TocCategory (Library) /texts/{cat/...}; Topic/PersonTopic/AuthorTopic /topics/{slug}; ref (Library) /{Ref_with_underscores}; User (Voices) /profile/{slug}; items with no URL filtered out.
- PersonTopic merged into Topic; sorted by type order (search, ref, Collection, TocCategory, Topic, PersonTopic, AuthorTopic, User, Term), grouped under titles (Books, Collections, Categories, Topics, Authors, Terms, Users).
- First item is always 'Search for: query' override whenever any completions exist (427-433). Icons per type; User shows profile picture or placeholder (7-17,47-53); Hebrew/English styling by label script.
- Rebuild: header combobox, 100 ms debounce, aborts the previous request, at least 3 characters; GET /api/name/<q>?type=Topic&type=ref&type=TocCategory&type=Term&topic_pool=library; groups in the old reversed order (Authors, Topics, Categories, Books) after the 'Search for …' row; submit resolves a ref, topic (external), category or the search page.

#### SRC-002 · Header search submit logic
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Pressing Enter either jumps straight to a recognized object or runs a full-text search.

- Enter (195-228): highlighted non-search item -> navigate to object (gtag search_navto 'Nav To by Keyboard'); otherwise submit query.
- Submit (491-503,453-490): highlighted 'search' item or enforceSearch (clicking Search-for item) -> plain search; else getQueryObj repairs case and gershayim variants (recursive).
- Ref (if allowed in module) -> onRefClick(ref) opens text (book -> TOC); events 'Search Box Navigation - Book/Citation', gtag search_submit 'Autolink'. Topic slug -> openTopic. Person/Collection/TocCategory -> redirect by URL. Else full-text search.
- Search: tracks 'Search / Search Box Search', gtag search_submit 'Search Results', trims query, opens search panel via showSearch (505-515). BUG-prone: on legacy Sheet Builder (sjs defined) does hard redirect to /search?q=.
- Box cleared after any submit/navigation; onNavigate closes mobile menu. redirectToObject encodes ? as %3F, tries openURL, falls back to window.location (517-526). Search button click with empty input focuses field (230-237).

### Autocomplete backend

#### SRC-031 · Name completion API
`core` `live` · rebuild: **n/a** — Server behaviour; the client calls this API (name, entity-search, search-wrapper, OpenSearch).

A single endpoint resolves typed text into a citation, topic override, exact object, or list of completions.

- Route api/name/<path:name> (urls_shared.py:107; standalone urls_name.py:20); view reader/views.py:3143-3199.
- Params: limit (default 10, 0=unlimited), type (repeatable), topic_pool, exact_continuations=1, order_by_matched_length=1.
- Always returns lang, is_ref, completions, completion_objects {title,type,key,is_primary,order,topic_pools[,pic]}.
- If a Ref: is_book/is_node/is_section/is_segment/is_range, type 'ref', ref, url, index, book, sections, examples; with numeric continuation also sectionNames, heSectionNames, addressExamples, heAddressExamples.
- topic_slug when '#' override matched; otherwise exact-name match returns type+key.
- Client Sefaria.getName(name, limit, types, topicPool, exactContinuations, orderByMatchedLength) trims, repeats type=, caches in _lookups.

#### SRC-032 · Completion candidate pipeline
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **n/a** — Server behaviour; the client calls this API (name, entity-search, search-wrapper, OpenSearch). `system`

Suggestions come from prefix matches first, then later-in-string matches, then spelling corrections.

- lang = he if name contains Hebrew else en; library.full_auto_completer(lang); Ref(name) tried first (sheet refs excluded).
- Pipeline: prefix matches (primary titles before alternates; ref alt titles <=4 chars like Gen/Exod skipped); later-in-string n-gram matches; spelling variants (Norvig checker) only if input <20 chars; autocorrected n-grams. Stops at limit unique strings.
- Each type gets 3 slots at normal rank, later items pushed down x100; optional re-sort by matched length.
- Input normalized (unidecode, apostrophes ' ’ ‘ ׳ stripped); inputs of 200+ chars return nothing.

Code: [`reader/views.py:3084`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/reader/views.py#L3084), [`sefaria/model/autospell.py:468`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/model/autospell.py#L468), [`sefaria/model/autospell.py:437`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/model/autospell.py#L437), [`sefaria/model/autospell.py:33`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/model/autospell.py#L33)

`core` `live` · rebuild: **done**

More results load automatically as the user scrolls near the bottom.

- Rebuild: IntersectionObserver sentinel 300px before the end; further pages start at the number of hits already loaded, up to the total; entity tabs page the same way (cap 10,000).

#### SRC-074 · Entity relevance ranking
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **n/a** — Server behaviour; the client calls this API (name, entity-search, search-wrapper, OpenSearch). `system`

Name search ranks exact title matches first, then phrase, all-words, prefix and any-word matches.

- ENTITY_SORTS: topic relevance/alpha; author & book relevance/alpha/year_asc/year_desc; alpha sorts title_en.sort; years sort sortYear (authors death else birth) or compDate; missing last; _score ties.
- Tiers: 1 exact case-insensitive keyword (primary 1000, variant/authored 100); 2 phrase on titles x4; 3 all words cross_fields AND x2; 4 all-words prefix x1.5 (multi-word); 5 phrase_prefix x1; 6 any word x0.1.
- Field boosts overridable via RemoteConfig SEARCH_ENTITY_FIELD_BOOSTS_{TOPIC,AUTHOR,BOOK}, allow-list validated.
- Descriptions never searched; tokenization mirrors exact_english analyzer (quote folding, combining marks, Hebrew ר׳).
- Topics and authors share the topic index filtered by subtype.

#### SRC-080 · Query construction and ranking

Text queries match phrases with lemmatized or exact fields, ranked by relevance or chronology.

#### SRC-082 · Dicta Hebrew Tanakh search merge
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested* `third-party`

Hebrew all-results queries also search Dicta's Tanakh index and replace Sefaria's own Tanakh hits.

- Active when type=text, query Hebrew, not exact (isDictaQuery); reset per new query.
- dictaQuery POSTs to sefaria.loadbalancer.dicta.org.il/search {query, from, size, limitedToBooks ('/'->'.', ' '->'_'), sort pagerank|corpus_order_path, smallUnitsOnly:true}; skipped when Dicta results exhausted.
- Hits adapted: version 'Tanach with Ta'amei Hamikra', lang he, isPrimary, heRef via reformatDictaRef, comp_date=-10000+i, score=-pagerank.
- dictaBooksQuery POST /books with 3 s timeout gives per-book counts as path buckets; on failure sets queryDictaFlag=false and falls back to Sefaria Tanakh hits silently.
- mergeQueries: replaces Sefaria Tanakh/* buckets with Dicta counts; total = matching buckets sum if filters else Sefaria+Dicta; removes Sefaria Tanakh hits, concatenates Dicta, sorts by score or comp_date; rescales Dicta scores to Sefaria mean/std.
- Sefaria scores negated (score=-_score) so ascending = best first.
- **BUG:** mean computation divides by sefariaHits.length for both sets.
- VERIFIED 2026-10-05 (scripts/parity-search.mjs): for the Hebrew query אור with 'All Results' sefaria.org shows 10,182+ sources, Tanakh (182) and Genesis 1:14 first — Dicta's Tanakh hits replace Sefaria's (the Sefaria API alone gives 10,000+, Tanakh (233), Genesis 1:3 first). The page's single search-wrapper POST (aggs ['path'] + 100 hits together) is unchanged; the Dicta calls go to another host.
- Rebuild: NOT built — it would send the user's Hebrew query to dicta.org.il, a third party. Owner decision needed. Until then Hebrew 'All Results' is Sefaria's own Tanakh hits (the old client's fallback when Dicta fails). Exact Phrase is identical to live.
- OWNER DECISION 2026-10-06: merge with Dicta as sefaria.org does. BUILT (src/lib/search/dicta.ts, a port of search.js dictaQuery/dictaBooksQuery/mergeQueries): Hebrew 'All Results' sends /search and /books to sefaria.loadbalancer.dicta.org.il beside Sefaria's own query (CORS: any origin, content-type allowed); Sefaria's Tanakh hits are dropped and Dicta's verses ('Tanach with Ta'amei Hamikra') merged; relevance rescales Dicta's -pagerank to Sefaria's mean/spread — the old quirk of dividing both means by the Sefaria count is KEPT so the order equals sefaria.org's; chronological puts Dicta first; filter-tree Tanakh counts are Dicta's; the total is the sum ('10,182+'), or under filters the merged buckets' sum; a failed /books (3 s timeout) or /search falls back to Sefaria's results. Every page re-sorts all hits loaded so far. VERIFIED with scripts/parity-search.mjs: 'אור' and 'שמע ישראל' (relevance), 'אור' chronological, filtered to Tanakh and to Talmud — tabs, first 2,500 characters of results and the filter list identical to sefaria.org.

#### SRC-094 · Search in this text (sidebar)
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** — Box, results, paging, query in URL, Hebrew keyboard, dictionary box for dictionary books. Not copied: remembering the query in memory after leaving the view (the address carries it). · *tested*

Users can search within the current book from the connections sidebar and jump to matches.

- ConnectionsPanel tool sets connectionsMode='SidebarSearch'; SearchButton + input #searchQueryInput placeholder 'Search in this text', maxLength 75, virtual keyboard; Enter (keyUp 13) or button submits only if value changed.
- Scope: Sefaria.bookSearchPathFilterAPI(title) -> /api/search-path-filter/<title> (searchRoot rewriting); SearchState text, appliedFilters [path], aggType path, field naive_lemmatizer, sortType chronological, filtersValid true.
- No exact toggle, no sort UI, no filter UI; no entity fetches or topic query; Hebrew queries still Dicta-merged.
- Renders ElasticSearchQuerier searchInBook -> SearchPage returns only SearchResultList.
- **BUG:** first query runs before path filter returns (filtersValid false) so briefly searches whole library, then second filtered query follows.
- Input #searchQueryInput with search button; Enter submits; max length 75; placeholder 'Search in this text'; pre-filled from sidebarSearchQuery on mount.
- Virtual Hebrew keyboard attached via VKI_attach when interface is English.
- Bookpath filter: GET /api/search-path-filter/<title> (category path + book); SearchState type 'text', field 'naive_lemmatizer', appliedFilters [path], appliedFilterAggTypes ['path'], sortType 'chronological'.
- Query persisted via setSidebarSearchQuery and URL sbsq.
- Results: ElasticSearchQuerier searchInBook=true; no topic query, no search analytics; rendered as SearchTextResult not cards; tracks 'SidebarSearch Query: ...' and 'Sidebar Search Result Click'.
- Click result: handleSidebarSearchClick replaces panel n-1 with that ref, highlights/scrolls to it, using result version (he if isPrimary else en) and textHighlights.
- Total-results and filter callbacks are only console.logged (SidebarSearch.jsx:117-118).
- VERIFIED 2026-10-05 (Genesis): URL load with sbsq=light sends THREE POSTs to /api/search-wrapper/es8 — (1) filters [] with aggs ['path'], (2) filters [''] (the path not yet known), (3) filters ['Tanakh/Torah/Genesis'] — only the last is shown. Typing a new query repeats the same three. Body of the last: field naive_lemmatizer, filter_fields ['path'], size 100, slop 10, sort_fields ['comp_date','order'], source_proj true, type text; no `start` on the first page.
- CORRECTION: the atlas said Hebrew queries are 'Dicta-merged' — the request for a Hebrew query is identical in shape (query: the Hebrew word as typed); nothing is merged client-side. Not ported.
- VERIFIED strings: placeholder and title 'Search in this text' / 'חפש בטקסט'; empty result '0 results.' / '0 תוצאות.'; results text for 'light' (112 hits) and the empty query identical to the rebuild's.
- LIVE QUIRK: the live panel can sit on a stale '0 results.' for several seconds after load (the intermediate unfiltered/empty-path queries resolve first); a URL-loaded Hebrew query only showed its results after ~10 s.
- REBUILD FACT (CORS): the search endpoint answers a browser POST from another origin only if it is a 'simple' request — content-type: application/json fails the preflight (Access-Control-Allow-Headers lacks content-type), content-type: text/plain works and the server still parses the JSON body. Same-origin on sefaria.org hides this. The rebuild sends text/plain and waits for the path filter, so only the final query runs.
- NOT YET REBUILT: Hebrew virtual keyboard (VKI) on the box; DictionarySearch instead of the box for dictionary books; remembering the query when returning to the view; next-page loading is implemented (start = hits loaded) but was not observed on the live site (112 hits, size 100: no second request appeared in a scroll probe).
- Strings from the interface file: searching = 'Searching...' / 'מבצע חיפוש...'; loading more = 'Loading more results...' / 'טוען עוד תוצאות...'.

### Search analytics

#### SRC-104 · GA4 search funnel events
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **deferred** — Analytics would send data to Sefaria: ask the owner. `system`

The main search page emits a structured funnel (flow started, query executed, element clicked, flow ended) to GA4.

- Scope: main search page only (not compare panel, sidebar search-in-book, or Voices); spec sc-46034.
- Events sent with transport_type 'beacon', undefined fields dropped.
- search_flow_started {flow_id, source nav_bar|back_click|deep_link|unknown}; nav_bar from showSearch; back_click from in-app popstate, performance back_forward, bfcache pageshow.
- search_query_executed {flow_id, search_id, search_text, status, result_counts JSON {sources,books,authors,topics}, error, tab}: fires once all four APIs report for current search_id; only first report per API counts; tab snapshot from query start.
- search_element_clicked {element_type tab|filter|sort|toggle|result, element_value, tab (live), count, result_position}.
- search_flow_ended {reason clicked_result|abandoned}; ends only once.

### Caching and accessibility

#### SRC-109 · Search caches
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested* `system`

Search, name lookup, lexicon and path-filter results are cached in memory for the session.

- Sefaria.search._cache; per-request ajax caches sefariaQuery|, dictaQuery|, dictaBooksQuery|; entity page cache; _lookups (getName), _lexiconCompletions, _bookSearchPathFilter; reset in Sefaria init (sefaria.js:4132-4172).
- Rebuild: every search request goes through TanStack Query with the `search` policy (5 min fresh, 30 min kept, not persisted): results pages, the aggregation query, entity searches, name suggestions and dictionary completions; the same request twice asks once.

#### SHE-002 · Sheet HTML import and export mapping
`core` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `owner`

Existing sheet text is converted in and out of the editor, preserving formatting from older sheets.

- parseSheetItemHTML: NBSP->space; if no lists <div>-><br>; nested lists flattened to one level; trailing newline dropped
- deserialize supports A (url, data-ref, target), BLOCKQUOTE, H1-H6, IMG, LI/OL/UL, P/DIV, PRE, TABLE/TR/TD, HR; marks EM/I/STRONG/B/U/SUP/BIG/SMALL; inline style background-color, color, text-align preserved
- serialize: marks to em/strong/u/sup/big/small, style marks to span style, newlines to <br>, ref links get class refLink + data-ref, paragraph <p> (or <div> with lists), tables <table><tbody>, <hr>
- saveSheetContent: SheetSource -> {ref, heRef, text{en,he} ('...' if empty), options?, node}; empty outsideText saved as '<p> </p>'; header -> <h1>; spacers dropped
- Save payload: status, id, promptedToPublish, lastModified, summary, options, tags, displayedCollection, title, sources, nextNode

### Editing behavior

#### SHE-015 · Editor Enter/Backspace and structure rules
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `owner`

The editor has custom rules for Enter, Backspace, cut/copy and tables so sources and spacers behave predictably.

- Enter in middle of outside text = soft break; in header = new outside text; on empty list item exits list; otherwise inserts spacer
- Backspace never past doc start; on SheetSource deletes it; from spacer selects rather than deleting source; end-of-doc spacer special handling
- Cut/copy of a source selects surrounding characters so void is cut
- Tables: no backspace/delete across cell boundaries; Enter disabled inside tables
- Scroll caret into view near viewport bottom (ensureInView)

### Saving

#### SHE-018 · Sheet autosave
`core` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `owner`

Changes to a sheet save automatically shortly after typing.

- Debounced 500ms after any change to content, title or summary; POST /api/sheets/ form field json
- Response updates status/title/summary and cache
- Optimistic concurrency: payload lastModified = cached dateModified; server rejects with 'Sheet updated.' rebuild:true if differs (sheets.py:476-481)
- Server recomputes includedRefs/expandedRefs on every save; sheetLanguage inferred from title (all-Hebrew -> hebrew)

#### SHE-019 · Save-state indicator and input lock
`core` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `owner` `desktop only`

The editor shows saved/saving/error state and blocks editing when saving fails so no work is silently lost.

### Reading history

#### USL-002 · Recently viewed / last place tracking
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `signed-in`

The app records what you are reading so it appears in history.

- saveLastPlace(panel,n,openingSidebar) -> Sefaria.saveUserHistory(getHistoryObject) (2161-2167); skips Connections panels and text panels without refs.
- History object: ref (highlighted range if sidebar open else currentlyVisibleRef), versions, book, language, sheet_owner, sheet_title; sheets use 'Sheet {id}:{node}' (2120-2143).

### Interface text

#### GUI-019 · Bilingual interface text rendering
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** — Tagged tests; checked against sefaria.org in the parity runs · *tested*

### Shared UI primitives

#### GUI-023 · Responsive grid and layout boxes
`core` `live` · rebuild: **todo**

Navigation cards flow into one, two or three columns depending on available width.

- NBox(content,n,stretch,gap): n-column flex grid with placeholder padding
- TwoOrThreeBox: 2 or 3 columns by width threshold
- ResponsiveNBox: 1/2/3 columns by measured container width; listens to window resize
- ResponsiveNBox measures own width (on mount and resize): >1500px -> 3 cols, >500 -> 2, else 1; wraps NBox.
- NBox n-column flex rows pads last row with placeholders unless stretch; optional gap. TwoOrThreeBox legacy (3 cols if width > 500 else 2).

### Google One Tap

#### ACC-002 · Google One Tap sign-in
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **todo**

Anonymous visitors may see a Google sign-in prompt, at most once per session.

- Skipped on /login and /register; shown once per session (sessionStorage sefaria_interruptive_ui_shown); waits 1.2s then re-checks auth path.
- Suppressed if interruptive UI present (cookie notice, site-wide banner, .modal, aria-modal dialog); then marked as shown.
- Posts credential to allauth provider-token endpoint with CSRF, reloads on success; waits for 'google-identity-loaded' event if GIS not yet loaded.
- Fires signup funnel analytics: flow_started, method_chosen, process_started/ended, flow_ended.

### SSO

#### ACC-012 · Sign in with Google and Apple
`core` `live` · rebuild: **todo**

Users can log in or register with Google or Apple; the same email always links to one account.

- Google Identity Services real button is portaled invisibly over the Continue with Google element (ChooseView or error banner) because the GIS button is a cross-origin iframe
- ux_mode redirect when Sefaria.ssoUseRedirect() (mobile, 767px or less or mobile UA) else popup; use_fedcm_for_button true; locale iw/en
- Redirect mode: login_uri=/api/auth/google/redirect; next via sefaria_sso_next cookie (SameSite=None; Secure; 300s) read by sso/adapters.py
- Popup mode: credential POSTed to allauth /_allauth/browser/v1/auth/provider/token; popup-abandon detection via window focus + 1200ms
- Apple: popup via AppleID.auth.init/signIn (scope name email) -> POST /api/auth/apple/callback with id_token+name+email; redirect mode -> /accounts/apple/login/?next=
- Errors routed to mounted view via setActiveErrorHandler
- Backend policy: SSO always wins on email collision - existing password account gets password wiped and becomes SSO-only
- New SSO users get Mongo profile + Gravatar + Salesforce CRM registration
- ErrorBanner sso_only_account variant lists providers with inline Continue links

### CMS pipeline

#### PRM-012 · Strapi CMS content pipeline
`core` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `system`

Banners, modals and sidebar ads are authored in a CMS and delivered to the site through a cached proxy.

- StrapiDataProvider wraps app (ReaderApp.jsx:2580); if STRAPI_INSTANCE set, one GraphQL query with per-locale aliases (en_banners, he_banners, en_modals ... he_sidebarAds) for docs whose date window is within +-14 days
- POST /api/strapi/graphql-cache?start_date=&end_date= (text/plain) to Django cache proxy (views.py:1513-1630) cached per date range
- Webhook POST /api/strapi/cache-invalidate clears *strapi_graphql* (views.py:1633-1669)
- Banner fields: internal name, dates, markdown text, button text/URL, showDelay, background color, shouldDeployOnMobile, audience flags (showTo, new/returning, sustainer), countriesToTarget
- Modal fields similar plus header/text; sidebar ad fields: title, body, button text/URL/icon, button above/below, blue background, campaign id, comma keywords with ! exclusions, showTo, dates, debug flag, newsletter-form flag + mailing lists
- Per-locale rows merged by documentId (strapiLocalization.js); bad rows dropped loudly
- Stale dismissal keys in localStorage pruned only on healthy payloads (context.js:241-271)
- **BUG:** shouldDeployOnMobile is fetched but not read by current selection code

Code: [`static/js/context.js:116`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/context.js#L116), [`static/js/context.js:187`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/context.js#L187), [`sefaria/views.py:1513`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/views.py#L1513), [`sefaria/views.py:1633`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/views.py#L1633)

#### PRM-013 · Promo eligibility, ranking and country targeting
`core` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `system`

The site chooses which banner or modal to show each visitor based on dates, language, location, audience and what they have already dismissed.

- Eligibility: date active, published in viewer locale, country match, audience match, not dismissed (strapiSelection.js:376-442)
- Ranking: country-specific > audience-specific > single-locale > shorter window > earlier start > payload order (:444-535)
- Display-only path exclusions: /donate, /mobile, /app, /ways-to-give and the page the CTA links to (:542-563)
- Viewer context: interface locale, country candidates, logged-in, Sefaria.is_sustainer, new/returning visitor (isNewVisitor/isReturningVisitor flags in session/localStorage, sefaria.js:2938-2958)
- Country targeting ALL/INCLUDE/EXCLUDE partition (strapiTargeting.js) using a set of candidates from IP country (Sefaria.countryCode), IANA timezone, navigator.language region (countryCandidates.js); US territories -> US; Crown dependencies add GB; he -> IL; bare fr -> CA

Code: [`static/js/sefaria/strapiSelection.js:376`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/sefaria/strapiSelection.js#L376), [`static/js/sefaria/strapiTargeting.js`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/sefaria/strapiTargeting.js), [`static/js/sefaria/countryCandidates.js`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/sefaria/countryCandidates.js), [`static/js/sefaria/sefaria.js:2938`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/sefaria/sefaria.js#L2938)

### Site banners

#### PRM-014 · Site-wide banner with maybe-later back-off
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **todo**

A generic promotional banner can be dismissed permanently or snoozed so it returns later, up to three times.

- Cookie names chatbot_experiment_banner_dismissed, signup_promo_banner_dismissed

## Language & accessibility


### Language domains

#### I18-001 · Content, translation and version preferences
`core` `live` · rebuild: **partial** — Translation and version preferences from cookies; content-language and country suggestion not yet

Reading language, translation language and per-corpus version choices are resolved from cookies, profile and country.

- Content language: ?lang -> contentLang cookie -> default (hebrew for he interface else bilingual); only english/hebrew/bilingual. If SITE_SETTINGS.TORAH_SPECIFIC false both forced english.
- Translation-language preference: profile -> translation_language_preference cookie;
- suggestion from country languages ∩ SUPPORTED_TRANSLATION_LANGUAGES (en, es, fr, de), never 'en', unless already suggested (translation_language_preference_suggested).
- Client setter writes both cookies and profile.
- Version preferences by corpus: profile attr -> version_preferences_by_corpus cookie (URL-encoded JSON).

Code: [`sefaria/system/middleware.py:151-182`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/system/middleware.py#L151-L182), [`static/js/ReaderApp.jsx:2144-2157`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/ReaderApp.jsx#L2144-L2157)

#### I18-003 · Tabbing detection and panel focus management
`core` `live` · rebuild: **partial** — New-panel focus done; sidebar focus on verse click intentionally not

Focus moves sensibly into new panels, and tab users get visible focus styling.

- user-is-tabbing body class added on first Tab keypress (Header.jsx:206-219); in multi-panel, when nothing focused and user is tabbing, focus moves to last panel's first focusable element after each update (ReaderPanel.jsx:100-103).
- Panel mounted at position > 0 focuses first focusable element (79-82); segment-click-opened sidebar does too (ReaderApp.jsx:1059-1064).
- When display settings open, focus goes to .on option in .readerOptionsPanel (legacy selector) (ReaderPanel.jsx:105-107).
- Rebuild: a panel opened beside the first takes keyboard focus on its first control; focus-visible rings replace the old 'user-is-tabbing' body class. Not rebuilt: focus into the sidebar when a verse opens it (it would take focus from the verse the reader just chose).

Code: [`static/js/Header.jsx:206`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/Header.jsx#L206), [`static/js/ReaderPanel.jsx:79`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/ReaderPanel.jsx#L79), [`static/js/ReaderPanel.jsx:100`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/ReaderPanel.jsx#L100)

#### I18-004 · Legacy toggle sets, tab view, radio, button a11y
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **todo**

- TabView: role=tablist/tab/tabpanel, aria-selected, roving tabindex, arrow-key via Util.handleTabKeyDown; with currTabName===null calls setTab(firstTab,true) on mount replacing history (400-504).

- CloseButton/ToolTipped/LanguageToggleButton support Enter/Space via Util.handleKeyboardClick; ToolTipped role=button tabIndex=0 with aria-label.

#### I18-009 · Interface string translation system
`core` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `system`

All interface strings are translated through keyed JSON files managed in Weblate, with Hebrew term fallbacks.

- strings.js imports i18n/interface/en.json + he.json (665 keyed IDs namespaced by component: common 60, nav_sidebar 52, search 49, auth 45, misc 35, sheets 32, header 27...); JSON is Weblate source of truth
- Sefaria._() resolves keyed IDs (regex /^[a-z0-9_]+(\.[a-z0-9_]+)+$/) from _i18nInterfaceStrings; falls back EN then id with console warning; non-ID strings use Hebrew term dictionary (hebrewTerm: terms from data.js, version title translations, built-in map, index heTitle) incl. 'a | b' splitting
- _v({en,he}) picks by interface; _bilingual(id,params) returns {en,he} with {placeholder} substitution; _r(ref) localized ref; _getShortInterfaceLang(); translateISOLanguageCode/ISOMap (sefaria.js:889)
- Content strings with both languages use {en,he} objects; CSS hides off-language int-en/int-he/en/he spans
- Server: Django gettext locale/{en,he}/LC_MESSAGES/django.po

#### I18-010 · Interface and content language resolution
`core` `live` · rebuild: **todo**

The site picks interface and content language automatically from the user's profile, cookies, location and browser, and keeps Hebrew domains in Hebrew.

- LanguageSettingsMiddleware (middleware.py:85-188): profile setting -> interfaceLang cookie -> Cloudflare cf-ipcountry (IL -> Hebrew) -> Accept-Language -> English
- Language-pinned domains (sefaria.org.il = Hebrew) redirect to matching domain preserving module/path with set-language-cookie, except crawlers
- LanguageCookieMiddleware (:209-233) sets cookie cross-domain and saves to profile
- Content language default: Hebrew interface -> hebrew else bilingual; ?lang= and contentLang cookie override
- Translation-language-preference suggestion = country languages intersect SUPPORTED_TRANSLATION_LANGUAGES (never English)
- Version preferences by corpus from profile or version_preferences_by_corpus cookie
- Order: profile interface_language -> interfaceLang cookie -> cf-ipcountry (IL -> hebrew) -> Accept-Language (he, he-il) -> english; only english/hebrew allowed.
- For /api/, /_api/, /linker*.js, /interface/, /accounts/, /_allauth/, AASA, /.well-known/, static: resolved from cookie/header only, no redirect, contentLang=bilingual.

Code: [`sefaria/system/middleware.py:85`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/system/middleware.py#L85), [`sefaria/system/middleware.py:209`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/system/middleware.py#L209), [`sefaria/system/middleware.py:85-127`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/system/middleware.py#L85-L127)

#### AI-002 · Library Assistant promo banner
`optional` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `desktop only`

A banner invites users to try the Library Assistant, with a polite 'maybe later' backoff.

- ChatbotExperimentBanner: logged-in Try it sets settings.library_assistant=true via Sefaria.editProfileAPI then reloads; logged-out Log in to try -> /login?next=/enable-library-assistant?next=<here>
- Excluded on /login, /register, /password/reset/confirm
- Shown by ReaderApp when library module, not mobile, show_join_chatbot_banner, not already in experiment; nudge schedule/session length from server props (ReaderApp.jsx:2575, 2589-2594)
- Hidden on /login, /register, /password/reset/confirm; renders nothing during SSR.
- Logged in: 'Try it' -> editProfileAPI({settings:{library_assistant:true}}) then reload. Anonymous: 'Log in to try' -> /login?next=/enable-library-assistant?next={current}.
- 'Maybe later': counter increments; 3 clicks dismiss forever; re-show needs both gates from NUDGE_SCHEDULE (overridable via promoMaybeLaterJSON): {1: 2 sessions & 7 days, 2: 4 sessions & 21 days}; session = gap >= promoSessionLengthSeconds (default 30 min).
- State in localStorage promo_backoff_{cookie}_* with migration from legacy dismissal cookie; cookie names chatbot_experiment_banner_dismissed (logged in), signup_promo_banner_dismissed (anonymous).
- Events: promo_viewed (once/session/cookie), promo_clicked with feature_name (join/login/maybe_later/close/learn_more); campaign 'LA Stand Alone Promo', project 'Library Assistant'.

# Platform


<a id="routing"></a>
## URLs & routing


### Architecture

#### RTE-001 · Library and Voices hosts split by domain
`core` `live` · rebuild: **deferred** — Depends on the owner's decisions on Voices, auth and hosting

The site is two products on separate hostnames: Library (texts) and Voices (sheets/community, called chiburim in Hebrew). The host decides which pages exist.

- ROOT_URLCONF is empty; django-hosts picks sefaria.urls_library or sefaria.urls_sheets from settings.DOMAIN_MODULES; unknown hosts fall to DEFAULT_HOST=library.
- DOMAIN_MODULES shape: {en:{library,voices}, he:{library,voices}}. Prod: sefaria.org / sefaria.org.il; voices subdomain is voices. (en) and chiburim. (he).
- Local example hosts: www.localsefaria.org:8000, voices.localsefaria.org:8000, www.localsefaria.org.il:8000, chiburim.localsefaria.org.il:8000.
- NAME_SERVICE=True pods route every host to sefaria.urls_name (autocomplete only).
- Module names 'library' and 'voices' (static/js/constants.js:27-28).
- HostsRequestMiddleware must be first and HostsResponseMiddleware last in MIDDLEWARE.

Code: [`sefaria/hosts.py:17-30`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/hosts.py#L17-L30), [`sefaria/settings.py:444-445`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/settings.py#L444-L445), [`sefaria/urls.py:1-3`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/urls.py#L1-L3), [`static/js/constants.js:27-28`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/constants.js#L27-L28)

Source: `inv_01_urls_routing.md#0.1`

#### RTE-002 · URLconf composition and catchall order
`core` `live` · rebuild: **replaced** — Django URL composition, middleware and global JS payloads have no equivalent in a TanStack Start app

Pages are matched in a fixed order, ending in a catchall that treats any single path segment as a text reference.

- Library: urls_library.urlpatterns + operational patterns + shared_patterns; Voices: urls_sheets.urlpatterns + shared_patterns.
- shared_patterns (urls_shared.py:20-315) + site_urlpatterns (sites/sefaria/urls.py via SITE_PACKAGE) + staticfiles + final catchall ^(?P<tref>[^/]+)(/)?$ -> reader.views.catchall.
- handler404 = reader.views.custom_page_not_found, handler500 = custom_server_error.
- First match wins; ordering causes shadowing bugs (see garden and edit/textinfo features).

Code: [`sefaria/urls_library.py:17-100`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/urls_library.py#L17-L100), [`sefaria/urls_sheets.py:15-39`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/urls_sheets.py#L15-L39), [`sefaria/urls_shared.py:20-321`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/urls_shared.py#L20-L321)

Source: `inv_01_urls_routing.md#0.2`

### Edge redirects

#### RTE-004 · Edge redirects to Voices for sheets, collections, profile
`core` `live` · rebuild: **deferred** — Depends on the owner's decisions on Voices, auth and hosting

On the library host, any /sheets, /collections or /profile path is bounced to the same path on the Voices host before it reaches Django.

- nginx rule ^/(sheets|collections|profile)(/.*|$) -> 307 to voices subdomain, same path; driven by values domains.modules[].redirects.
- This is why library Django has no /sheets/<id>, /collections, /profile/<slug> routes; local dev without nginx 404s on library host.
- Dead Django equivalents: collections_redirect, profile_redirect_to_voices, sheets_redirect_to_voices (reader/views.py:5274-5310) are not routed.

### Middleware

#### RTE-008 · Request middleware affecting URL behavior
`core` `live` · rebuild: **replaced** — Django URL composition, middleware and global JS payloads have no equivalent in a TanStack Start app `system`

A fixed middleware chain decides module, language, location, cookies and redirects before any view runs.

- SessionCookieDomainMiddleware: session/CSRF cookie Domain = common suffix of all module hosts of same language (.sefaria.org) so login is shared library<->voices;
- optionally expires legacy domain-less cookies when remote config EXPIRE_LEGACY_COOKIES.
- SessionIDAuthMiddleware: authenticates anonymous requests via encrypted X-Session-ID header (chatbot token).
- UserAgentMiddleware: request.user_agent.is_mobile drives multiPanel.
- ModuleMiddleware: request.active_module from host, default library; forced library for /linker.js, /api/, /_api/, /apple-app-site-association, /static/ (but /api/img-gen/ is processed).
- LocationSettingsMiddleware: country_code from Cloudflare cf-ipcountry (XX/missing -> PINNED_IPCOUNTRY or 'us'); request.diaspora = country != 'il'.
- WebSessionRedirectMiddleware: appends no_applink=1 to redirect Locations continuing a web session (OAuth callback or sefaria Referer) so iOS universal links do not hijack.
- LanguageCookieMiddleware: handles ?set-language-cookie (see Language domains).
- ProfileMiddleware: ?prof (DEBUG only) returns cProfile output; ?sort= sorts it.
- ClearSsoNextCookieMiddleware: deletes sefaria_sso_next cookie on /api/auth/google/redirect and /accounts/apple/login/callback/finish/.

Code: [`sefaria/settings.py:119-147`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/settings.py#L119-L147), [`sefaria/system/middleware.py:65-82`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/system/middleware.py#L65-L82), [`sefaria/system/middleware.py:236-356`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/system/middleware.py#L236-L356), [`sefaria/system/middleware.py:469-516`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/system/middleware.py#L469-L516)

Source: `inv_01_urls_routing.md#0.4`

#### RTE-022 · Sheet URLs
`core` `live` · rebuild: **deferred** — Depends on the owner's decisions on Voices, auth and hosting

Source sheets open at /sheets/<id>, optionally with a highlighted node, or /sheets/new to start a fresh one.

- editor=True because Referer path == /sheets/new (reader/views.py:699-701); client replaces URL with /sheets/<id> on mount.
- /sheets/visual/<int:id> -> legacy sheets_visual.html.
- A /Sheet.<id> text URL on library renders a sheet in library (reader/views.py:807-812).
- Client-written hash #afterLoading=exportToDrive and legacy #onload=exportToDrive trigger Google Drive export after OAuth; location.hash preserved on history push/replace.
- Legacy ?editor=1 emitted by old sheets.js; React app ignores it.
- Sheet panels in non-first positions serialize as p<N>=sheet&s<N>=... which the server cannot parse (see multi-panel feature).

### Shared page URLs

#### RTE-026 · Text reader URL (catchall)
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Any single-segment path that is not another route is treated as a text reference and opens the reader, book page, or a sheet.

- Route: ^(?P<tref>[^/]+)(/)?$ -> reader.views.catchall; trailing slash accepted without redirect.
- Book-level ref (/Genesis) -> panel menuOpen 'book toc' with indexDetails (content counts + relatedTopics) and versions; with ?notes=1 -> 'extended notes' page.
- Torah refs include indexDetails for parashah headers.
- Segment-level or ranged refs set highlightedRefs = each segment.
- Spanning refs split into a refs list; super-section or empty refs jump to first section with content via first_available_section_ref().
- Voices host: a non-sheet ref -> 301 to library domain, same path+query (redirect_to_module).
- InputError on parse -> 404.
- FOUND 2026-10-05: client-side navigation to a title with a comma wrote %2C (TanStack encodes path params); the old site and a direct load keep the comma ('/Jastrow,_אוֹר', '/Mishneh_Torah,_Shabbat.1.1'). Fixed with `pathParamsAllowedCharacters: [',', ':', '@']` in src/router.tsx.

#### RTE-027 · Ref URL normalization to canonical form
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Any variant of a citation (case, alt title, Hebrew title, 'Genesis 1:1', 'Gen.1.1') redirects to one canonical URL.

- Parsed via Ref.instantiate_ref_with_legacy_parse_fallback: plain Ref -> on PartialRefInputError, normalize title + per-index Mongo-backed LegacyRefParser (e.g.
- old Zohar refs) -> else partially matched ref.
- Canonical = oref.url(False): normal English ref, spaces -> '_', ':' -> '.', last '_' before sections -> '.' (Mishna_Brachot_2:3 -> Mishna_Brachot.2.3); '?' -> %3F with encode_html.
- Differing incoming tref -> 301 to canonical with query string preserved.
- Legacy /<tref>/<lang>/<version> -> 301 /<tref>?v<lang>=<version>&<orig params> (old_versions_redirect).
- Client TextRange replaces history (no new entry) when loaded data's normalized ref differs, ref is spanning (split refs) or super-section (firstAvailableSectionRef).
- Client-only: commentary refs with a single base text and depth >=3 (Rashi on Genesis 1:1:1) open as base text Genesis 1:1 + sidebar filter Rashi; server does NOT do this for direct URL loads.

#### RTE-028 · Version parameter normalization redirect
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Version choices in the URL are checked against the text's real versions; stale or legacy values are rewritten or dropped.

#### RTE-032 · Login, register and logout URLs
`core` `live` · rebuild: **deferred** — Depends on the owner's decisions on Voices, auth and hosting

Sign-in, sign-up and logout have their own addresses and open the in-app auth page.

- /login: CustomLoginView, React page (headerMode False), ReaderApp shows AuthPage login flow; logged-in -> 302 '/'; title 'Log in to Sefaria'.
- /register: React AuthPage register flow; POST creates user; ?next=; ?educator=1 pre-checks educator subscribe; POST noredirect -> JSON;
- success appends welcome=to-sefaria to next (except new?assignment= nexts); next validated against host; logged-in -> 302 '/'.
- logout: GET or POST, then ?next (host-validated); client builds /logout?next=/texts (library) or /logout?next=/ (voices).
- /password/reset/confirm/<uidb64>/<token>/: AuthPage reset flow with authResetUid, authResetValid; POST JSON sets password; POST {action:'resend'} re-emails.
- Client resolveInitialAuthState: path /login, /register (optional trailing /) or authResetUid -> showAuth.
- openURL turns /login and /register links into in-app AuthPage with next = current path; data-signup-source captured for funnel analytics.
- Client helpers withNext, safeNext (same-origin check) in static/js/auth/utils.js.
- No first-party JS reads the welcome param (presumably analytics/GTM).

#### RTE-042 · Version selection params (ven, vhe)
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done**

The URL records which English-side/translation and Hebrew/primary version is displayed.

- ven/vhe value format '<languageFamilyName>|<Version_Title>' with '_' for spaces; _extract_version_params -> currVersions.en (translation) / .he (primary).
- Pre-normalized by _get_current_and_normalized_versions (see version normalization).
- Missing -> {languageFamilyName:'',versionTitle:''} -> server picks defaults ('primary'/'translation').
- Client writer Sefaria.util.getUrlVersionsParams: &ven=family|Title_With_Underscores, ';' -> %3B (encodeVtitle).
- ven<N>/vhe<N> for panel N (suffix only when i>1), then override_version_with_preference for extra panels.
- Per-book cached version from defaultVersions used when no version is set for the displayed language.

#### RTE-044 · Connections sidebar param (with)
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

The URL records which sidebar view or commentary filter is open next to the text.

- Client writes &with=<sources>: filter list joined by '+', or connectionsMode if in sidebarModes, ' ConnectionsList' suffix for category lists, WebPage:<site> for web pages list.

#### RTE-049 · Multiple panels in the URL (p<N> params)
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Side-by-side panels are encoded in the URL as numbered params so a multi-panel session can be shared.

- p<N> (N>=2) = additional panel ref; p<N>=search -> search panel; invalid refs silently skipped.
- Per-panel suffixed params: ven<N>/vhe<N>, w<N> (connections filter; all->[]), lang<N>, aliyot<N>, notes<N>, lookup<N>, sbsq<N>, namedEntity<N>, namedEntityText<N>, vside (base only).
- Search panel: q<N>, tab<N>, search_tab<N>, tpathFilters<N> via get_search_params; URL is search&q=...&tab=... with '=' replaced by '<N>='.
- Client merge: Text/Sheet followed by Connections at i=1 -> short form /<ref>?...&with=<sources> (+ vside, lookup, namedEntity, sbsq, namedEntityText, debug_mode);
- for i>=2 Connections -> &p<i>=<connections ref> + versions/lang/aliyot of preceding text panel.
- Other panels -> &p<i+1>=... with every '=' in sub-URL suffixed by i+1; titles joined with 'and'.
- **BUG:** sheet in non-first panel serializes p<N>=sheet&s<N>=... which server cannot parse (Ref('sheet') fails) -> panel dropped.
- Final step: all '?' in URL -> %3F (refs with question marks), then first '&' -> '?'.

### Client history and URL state

#### RTE-053 · URL generation per panel type (makeHistoryState)
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done**

Every panel state is turned into a URL and title, so each screen is addressable.

- Auth: {state:{showAuth,authPath,authSource,panels:[]}, url:authPath}.
- navigation -> /texts[/<cats>]; voices -> /; sheetsWithRef -> /sheets-with-ref/<encodeURIComponent(en ref)> + 's' search params; book toc -> /<Book_Title>; extended notes -> /<Book>&notes[i]=1.
- search -> /search&q=<enc>&tab=<text|sheet>&search_tab=<tab> + t/s filter params; topics -> /topics/<slug> (or /topics/<testVersion>/<slug>) + &sort=, /topics/category/<cat>, /topics;
- allTopics -> /topics/all/<letter>.
- profile -> /profile/<slug>; collection -> /collections/<slug>&tag=; editCollection -> /collections/<slug>/settings or /collections/new; collectionsPublic -> /collections;
- translationsPage -> /translations/<slug>; sheets -> /; updates -> /updates; linkerEditor -> /linker-editor&book=; user_stats -> /torahtracker; notes -> /texts/notes;
- also notifications, calendars, modtools, saved, history.
- Text panel: URL ref = highlighted range if it overlaps currentlyVisibleRef else currentlyVisibleRef, via Sefaria.normRef; &aliyot= for Torah; currVersions -> ven/vhe.
- Connections panel: sources = WebPage:<filter> or filter list/sidebar mode/'all' with ' ConnectionsList' suffix; adds versionFilter, SidebarSearch query, Lexicon words/entity.
- TextAndConnections (mobile) -> /<ref>?with=<sources>.
- Sheet panel 0 -> /sheets/<id>[.<node>].
- No panels (headerMode over static page): URL = current path + query; title = document.title.

#### RTE-054 · Push vs replace history behavior
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Browser history only gets a new entry for meaningful navigation; scrolling and refinements quietly update the current entry.

- Called from componentDidMount with replace=true and from every componentDidUpdate; skipped right after popstate (justPopped).
- shouldHistoryUpdate compares to history.state: showAuth/authPath, panel count, mode, menuOpen, bookRef, last ref, highlightedRefs, filter, connectionsMode, connectionData, currVersions, searchQuery,
- tab, topicSort, collectionName/Tag, linkerEditorBook, search filters/field/sort, settings.language, settings.aliyotTorah, navigationTopicCategory, navigationTopic, navigationCategories,
- highlightedNode, sheet title availability.
- **BUG:** versionFilter check calls prev.versionFilter(next.versionFilter) as a function and keys off next.mode (never 'Translation Open') (ReaderApp.jsx:447).
- Push never pushes an identical URL; then trackPageview. Title set via $('title').html(hist.title).
- Replace used for: scroll/infinite load (updateTextColumn), currentlyVisibleRef change, setTextListHighlight/setFocusedText, collection name load, language option change,
- ref normalization in TextRange, mobile TextAndConnections focus changes, setTab on TabView mount, Linker Admin params, SearchPage programmatic tab.
- On replace with changed URL, delayed (3s) intent analytics.
- Client preserves location.hash on push/replace.
- BUG (VERIFIED 2026-10-05): selecting a verse adds TWO history entries — /Genesis.1.2?lang=en&with=all, then the same URL with &lang2=en appended (a second push). One Back press therefore lands on the same view with the sidebar still open. Loading a Torah page likewise rewrites the URL (&aliyot=0, RTE-064), costing another entry. The rebuild adds one entry per choice and never rewrites the URL after load.

#### RTE-055 · Back/forward and scroll restoration
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Using the browser back button restores previous panels, search state and scroll position.

- Scroll position persisted into history.state.scrollPosition (300ms debounce) and restored on pop.
- handlePopState: restores panels (re-hydrating SearchState objects), labels search-analytics source 'back_click' when popping into search, deep-clones panels.
- VERIFIED 2026-10-05: after Back/Forward the text column's scrollTop is restored from history state (643 after returning from a later scroll position).
- Rebuild: each history entry remembers every panel's place as a segment ref plus its offset from the column top (not a raw scrollTop, which is meaningless once the column holds different sections); saved at every history change while the page being left is still on screen, kept in sessionStorage, restored before paint on Back/Forward. Back to a different text starts a new column for it.
