### Language domains

#### RTE-059 · Language-domain redirect
`core` `live` · rebuild: **deferred** — Depends on the owner's decisions on Voices, auth and hosting

A user whose language does not match the language-specific domain is bounced to the other-language domain.

- If host is pinned to a language (current_domain_lang; ambiguous hosts like localhost unpinned) and differs from interface language: humans 302 to the same module on the other-language domain with
- ?set-language-cookie.
- LanguageCookieMiddleware on target sets interfaceLang cookie (cookie domain = language's common suffix), saves to profile, redirects to same URL minus the param.
- Crawlers/bots get the domain's language with no redirect: Googlebot, Bingbot, Slurp, DuckDuckBot, Baiduspider, YandexBot, Facebot, facebookexternalhit, ia_archiver, Sogou, python-request, curl, Wget,
- sefaria-node.
- PROBE NOTE 2026-10-05: an automated visit to www.sefaria.org from this machine was redirected to www.sefaria.org.il with a Hebrew interface (geo/language domain redirect); set the interfaceLang=english cookie for www.sefaria.org to keep English.

### Sidebar deep links

#### RTE-062 · Sidebar mode in URL (with= param)
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** · *tested*

Sidebar state is encoded in the URL so a specific tool, filter or category can be shared or opened in a new tab.

- makeHistoryState sidebarModes: Sheets, Notes, Translations, Translation Open, Version Open, About, AboutSheet, Navigation, WebPages, extended notes, Topics, Torah Readings, manuscripts, Lexicon, SidebarSearch, Guide, LinkerAdmin.
- with= carries joined filter ('+' separated), the mode name if a sidebar mode, or 'all'; ConnectionsList appends ' ConnectionsList'; WebPagesList written 'WebPage:<site>'.
- Extra params: vside (version filter), lookup (selected words), namedEntity, namedEntityText, sbsq (sidebar search query), debug_mode=linker, lang2 (sidebar language).
- Panels after the first use w{i}, vside{i}, lookup{i}, namedEntity{i}, namedEntityText{i}, sbsq{i}.
- **BUG:** sbsq{i} written without '$' (`&sbsq{i}=`) so sidebar search query lost for panels after the first (ReaderApp.jsx:858).
- **BUG:** server reads 'vside' instead of 'vside{i}' for panels 2+ (reader/views.py:881).
- Page title: '<ref> with <mode/filter>' unless value is 'all' or a ConnectionsList.
- Server get_connections_mode/make_panel_dict: 'with' ignored in voices module; with=all -> empty filter; '_' -> space; sidebar-mode names delete the filter; 'X ConnectionsList' sets connectionsCategory; 'WebPage:x' sets webPagesFilter; lang2 sets connections language; highlightedRefs/showHighlight set when filter present.
- Tools buttons are real <a href=replaceUrlParam('with',mode)> so ctrl-click opens that mode in a new tab; category/text filters link to /<ref>?with=<Category> ConnectionsList or ?with=<Book>.
- When writing history, SidebarSearch panel's refs overwritten with previous panel's refs.

### SSR

#### PLT-003 · Server-side rendering pipeline
`core` `live` · rebuild: **done** — Server-rendered text, canonical redirects, prev/next links `system`

Pages are rendered on a Node server for fast first paint and SEO, then hydrated in the browser.

- render_template merges base_props + view props + remoteConfig (CLIENT_REMOTE_CONFIG_JSON) -> propsJSON; if view props present, POSTs to Node NODE_HOST/ReaderApp/todo and injects HTML;
- otherwise renderStatic=True (header only, client-rendered).
- Node down/timeout -> elements/loading.html placeholder (logo per module/lang) unless FAIL_IF_NODE_SSR_UNAVAILABLE.
- node/server.js loads shared data (toc, topic_toc, terms, books, virtualBooks) from Redis, refreshing when Django's last_cached is newer;
- Sefaria.setup(data, props, resetCache=true), unpackDataFromProps, renderToString(ReaderApp).
- templates/base.html: #s2 holds SSR HTML; static pages use #staticContentWrapper/#content and #s2.headerOnly; DJANGO_VARS = {props, inReaderApp:!renderStatic}; STRAPI_INSTANCE.

### Meta and SEO

#### PLT-006 · Page titles and meta descriptions
`core` `live` · rebuild: **partial** — Page titles done; meta descriptions not `system`

Each page gets a title and description tailored to its type and module.

- {% meta_title %} emits <title>, og:title, twitter:title; {% meta_desc %} emits description, og:description, twitter:description.
- get_page_title(base, module, page_type): '<title> | <suffix>'; home suffix 'Voices on Sefaria' / 'Sefaria: a Living Library of Jewish Texts Online';

- Sheet titles strip tags; empty -> 'Untitled'. Client mirror Sefaria.getPageTitle with i18n keys.
- Text page description = first ~160 chars of segment text (interface-language first, fallback other; bleach-cleaned, word-truncated + ellipsis) or book enDesc/heDesc + 'Read the text of X online...';
- sheets = summary or default; topics, categories, search, translations have specific descriptions.

#### PLT-025 · robots.txt
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `system`

Crawling rules are served by nginx from deployment config and block everything on non-production.

### Scheduled Jobs

#### PLT-032 · Scheduled jobs (cron) overview
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `system`

Background jobs refresh sitemaps, metrics, trends, caches, search indexes, topic data, web pages and embeddings on a schedule.

- sitemaps 05:00 daily (generate_sitemaps.py -> GCS sefaria-sitemaps); metrics 01:00 daily (metrics.py -> db.metrics powering /metrics);
- trends 01:00 Sat (recalculate_trends.py -> trend.setAllTrends for trending topics).
- regenerate-long-cached-data 06:00 Sat (version-status tree for /visualize/library, bare-links and link-count APIs for the 7 Link Explorer category pairs, purge Varnish);
- index-from-queue every 7 min (search-index queue -> ES); reindex-elasticsearch (+ES6) Fri 21:00 (reindex_orchestrator.py, reindex_pipeline.py).
- topics-indexing / recalculate_secondary_topic_data.py Mon 00:00; rambi-webpages-weekly (parse_rambi_webpages.py) Sat 00:00 harvests web pages for sidebar; embed-library-to-pgvector (+metadata)
- per values.yaml schedule (semantic search); text-export per export.enabled/schedule.
- webpages_cronjob (scripts/scheduled/webpages_cronjob.py;
- no Helm CronJob found, manual/external): dedupes WebPage collection, finds sites that stopped using linker / non-whitelisted sites / sites needing exclusions, posts to Trello + Slack.
- mongo-backup (daily 00:00), mongo-backup-extra (Sun 02:00), postgres-backup (Sun 00:00), sync-*-production-data (Sun 02:00) are infra, not user-facing.
- reader/management/commands/runserver.py is the only reader management command.

Code: [`helm-chart/sefaria/templates/cronjob/sitemaps.yaml:1`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/helm-chart/sefaria/templates/cronjob/sitemaps.yaml#L1), [`scripts/scheduled/generate_sitemaps.py:1`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/scripts/scheduled/generate_sitemaps.py#L1), [`scripts/scheduled/metrics.py:1`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/scripts/scheduled/metrics.py#L1)

### Texts API

#### API-002 · Texts API v3 (/api/v3/texts)
`core` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `third-party`

The canonical text endpoint returns one or more versions of a ref with metadata and warnings.

- GET /api/v3/texts/<tref> (api/views.py:28-88, TextRequestAdapter).
- Query: version (repeatable; 'lang|versionTitle', underscores=spaces;
- special primary, source, translation, all, language codes), fill_in_missing_segments=0|1, return_format in [default, wrap_all_entities, text_only, strip_only_footnotes], debug_mode (e.g. linker).
- Returns versions[], ref metadata, warnings[] (101 NoVersion, 102 NoLanguageVersion, 103 NoSourceText, 104 NoTranslationText from api_warnings.py). 404 if ref has no text and node not virtual;
- 400 bad return_format.

Code: [`api/views.py:28`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/api/views.py#L28), [`api/api_warnings.py:1`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/api/api_warnings.py#L1)

#### LNK-005 · Linker page-scan and wrapping pipeline
`core` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `third-party`

The plugin reads the page's main text, asks Sefaria to find citations, and wraps each found citation in a link in the page.

- Text via Mozilla Readability on a document clone (tables and <sup> removed), serializer adds newlines at non-prose elements, DOMPurify-sanitized (getReadableText :97-103);
- whitelist selector text added if not covered (:21-29).
- POST ${sefariaUrl}/api/find-refs?with_text=<1 if popup mode>&debug=<0|1>&max_segments=20 with {text:{title,body}, metaDataForTracking:{url (canonical unless dynamic), description, title},
- version_preferences_by_corpus}.
- Server returns 202 {task_id}; client polls GET /api/async/<task_id> with p-retry (15 retries, 500ms..5s, factor 1.5, 120s cap) until SUCCESS.
- wrapRef (:275-306) locates citation text via findAndReplaceDOMText, disambiguating repeated strings by expanding context up to 10 words ('unique enough' > 30 chars, tolerance 5);
- wraps in <a class='sefaria-ref' target=_blank data-ref data-result-index data-result-key aria-controls='sefaria-popup'> with 'all: unset' inline styles.
- Skips failed links and ambiguous (>1 refs) unless debug. excluder.js never links text inside <a> and honors excludeFromLinking; tracking exclusion hook exists but unused (TODO).
- bindRefClickHandlers sets href=<base>/<url>?lang=<xx>&utm_source=<host>&utm_medium=sefaria_linker (popup.js:406-425).

Code: [`static/js/linker.v3/main.js:388`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/linker.v3/main.js#L388), [`static/js/linker.v3/main.js:275`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/linker.v3/main.js#L275), [`static/js/linker.v3/popup.js:406`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/linker.v3/popup.js#L406)

Source: `inv_08b_admin_linker_apps.md#2.3`

#### LNK-006 · Linker popup UI
`core` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `third-party`

Hovering or clicking a linked citation opens a draggable, accessible popup showing the text in Hebrew and/or English with a link to read more.

- popup-hover: mouseover show, mouseout hide.

- flips left/right, 'short-screen' shrink, recenters if off-screen.

- No XFrameOptionsMiddleware/X-Frame-Options/CSP frame-ancestors found in settings, middleware or nginx, so framing is allowed by default.
- edit_text.html standalone also carries EMBED class.

## Admin & moderator tools


### Linker admin

#### ADM-001 · Linker Admin sidebar
`optional` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `moderator`

A moderator debugging panel for inspecting and fixing how the linker resolved a citation.

- Entry: Advanced -> Linker Admin Tools; or in linker debug mode, moderator clicks resolved citation (a.mutc) which opens LinkerAdmin with connectionData.linkerAdminSpan, stores Sefaria._linkerAdminSelectedCitation and updates URL (ReaderPanel.jsx:194-207).
- Non-moderators or non-citation spans get a debug alert dumping status (SUCCESS/FAILED/AMBIGUOUS), ref, parts, part types, context ref/type, CRRD test string, topic slug or category path (sefaria.js:678-689).
- Debug mode: debug_mode=linker added to v3 text API calls (sefaria.js:644); linker_output collected into _linkerOutputMap[ref|lang|charRange]; toggle switch reloads page with param on/off.
- 'Current Ref' = selected span's ref or currently visible reader ref (follows scrolling); selection cleared when visible ref moves from span's segment.
- Display: single status line; 'Linker Resolution(s)': Disambiguated/Ambiguous/plain title; options sorted with rejected (llm_ambiguous_option_valid===false) last, each 'Linker → Disambiguator' refs.
- Ref Parts chips colour-coded by type (NAMED, NUMBERED, DH, RANGE, RANGE_SYMBOL, IBID, RELATIVE, NON_CTS) with 'from curr. book / ibid' label.
- 'Options considered': parsings valid first then by matched parts; invalid show disqualification reason; collapsible 'Ref Part / Node Pairings' with node ref links.
- CRRD Test String: click to copy, 'Copied to clipboard' 2s; format crrd(["@x","#1",...], lang='en') (sefaria.js:710-745).

Code: [`static/js/LinkerAdminBox.jsx`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/LinkerAdminBox.jsx), [`static/js/sefaria/sefaria.js:644`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/sefaria/sefaria.js#L644), [`static/js/sefaria/sefaria.js:678`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/sefaria/sefaria.js#L678), [`static/js/ReaderPanel.jsx:194`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/ReaderPanel.jsx#L194)

`optional` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `moderator`

Moderator actions to rerun the linker, delete or recreate a link, reparse parts and add training dataset entries.

- Re-parse: POST /_api/linker-admin/citation/parse {parts,lang,contextRef,prevRefs}; ranged parts flattened into NUMBERED, RANGE_SYMBOL, NUMBERED; ibid context passed as prevRefs.
- + Ref Dataset POST /_api/linker-admin/dataset/ref (reports number of labels); + Ref Part Dataset POST /_api/linker-admin/dataset/ref-part.

### Ops Endpoints

#### ADM-032 · Cache and rebuild admin URLs
`standard` `live` · rebuild: **todo** `staff`

Staff trigger cache resets and rebuilds (library, one text, counts, table of contents, autocompleter, Varnish) by visiting admin URLs, usually landing back on the homepage with a flash message.

- /admin/reset/cache (library.rebuild + Redis multiserver publish + Varnish invalidate; redirect /?m=Cache-Reset; also served during maintenance mode).
- /admin/reset/cache/<title> refresh one index (falls back to DB load when a Celery rename has not propagated). /admin/reset/counts/all and /<title> refresh VersionState.
- /admin/reset/toc library.rebuild_toc (used by bulk CSV upload). /admin/reset/ac rebuilds full, lexicon and cross-lexicon autocompleters.
- /admin/reset/varnish/<tref>; /admin/reset/api/<apiurl> re-runs a django_cache-decorated API view with action=reset;
- /admin/reset/<tref> book-level refresh index cache+VersionState+ToC+Varnish, sub-ref Varnish only; /admin/reset-websites-data reloads WebSite collection.
- /admin/delete/orphaned-counts remove_old_counts + template-cache purge.
- /admin/rebuild/shared-cache: csrf-exempt, @webhook_auth_or_staff_required, library.init_shared_cache(rebuild=True) if not already regenerating.
- Rebuild gotcha: these are GET URLs that 302 to /?m=<Message>; a flash-message handler is needed on the home page (or replace with real admin UI).

### Version Compare

#### LEG-010 · Text version diff/compare tool (/compare)
`optional` `legacy` · rebuild: **todo** `desktop only`

A public page compares two versions of a text segment by segment with inline diffs, and lets users click a change to apply it to the text.

- Route ^compare/?((?P<comp_ref>[^/]+)/)?((?P<lang>en|he)/)?((?P<v1>[^/]+)/)?(?P<v2>[^/]+)?$ -> views.py:2191-2217 compare (NOT staff-gated);
- template compare.html + bundle diffPage.js (diff_page.jsx 719 lines; React 15, jQuery 2.2, jQuery UI from cdnjs).
- DataForm: ref input, language select (he/en only, TODO to generalize), two Version selects from Sefaria.getVersions(ref), 'Load Diff'. DiffTable of DiffRow;
- each fetches segment text for both versions via Sefaria.text(segRef,{enVersion/heVersion, wrapLinks:0}).
- DiffCell uses diff-match-patch; DiffStore strips HTML tags and maps positions; ValidateDiff only allows changes not touching tags.
- Clicking an inserted/deleted fragment opens a dialog applying the change via Sefaria.postSegment(segRef, vtitle, lang, text) i.e. WRITES text (server auth applies).
- 'Load Next Chapter' via Sefaria.getRef(...).next; filter checkboxes (י ו " : ' ( ) ) toggle 'filtered' class on ins/del spans; book-level ref expands to first section with refArray;
- props {secRef,v1,v2,lang,refArray}.
- **SECURITY:** public page whose Apply action writes text; relies entirely on server-side auth of postSegment.

Code: [`sefaria/views.py:2191`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/sefaria/views.py#L2191), [`static/js/diff_page.jsx:167`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/diff_page.jsx#L167), [`static/js/diff_page.jsx:561`](https://github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Project/blob/bb47dd77a5d92b55814ba221199f1e39ad66d021/static/js/diff_page.jsx#L561)
